title: Joseon–United States Treaty of 1882
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Joseon–United States Treaty of 1882", at revision 1378967523, opens: "A Treaty of Peace, Amity, Commerce and Navigation between the United States of America and the Kingdom of Corea or Chosen, also known as the Shufeldt Treaty, was negotiated between United States and Korea’s Joseon dynasty in 1882." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q697104, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1882 treaty between the United States and Korea that established their mutual relationship". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
